description: The reader asks for the exact line to copy into a notebook. Muse must quote the retrieved passage word for word and say where it comes from.

input.reader_message: What are the exact words when she first follows the rabbit down? I want to copy the line into my notebook.

librarian_evidence: burning with curiosity, she ran across the field after it, and fortunately was just in time to see it pop down a large rabbit-hole under the hedge.
In another moment down went Alice after it, never once considering how in the world she was to get out again.

criteria: quotes the retrieved passage exactly, in quotation marks
locates the line in Chapter I
does not alter, splice, or embellish the source words
forbidden_claims: wording that is not in the retrieved passages presented as the book's words
